content_blocks.label: clause_1._Premises
content_blocks.text: The Landlord hereby leases to the Tenant the Premises located at 123 Main Street, Springfield City.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Term
content_blocks.text: The Term of this Lease shall commence on July 1, 2024 and shall continue until June 30, 2029, unless terminated earlier as provided herein.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Rent
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay to the Landlord a monthly rent of $1,500, payable in advance on the first day of each month.
